_README: Amendment A23. 21 of the 419 studies are keyed by an OpenAlex work id rather than a PubMed id,
because that is where retrieval found them. The site built pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/<id>/ from
those ids unconditionally, so 21 study pages linked to a PubMed record that does not exist.
Resolved through the OpenAlex API: 0 of the 21 have a PubMed id, 20 have a DOI. Links therefore
go to doi.org, which resolves. openalex.org itself is not used: it sits behind bot protection and
serves a challenge page to automated clients, so it is not a dependable destination for a reader.
Committed as data so the site build needs no network access.
